defs.def: happening or existing before sth else or before a particular time 先前的；较早的；在前的

ex.s: Learn from prior experience to slow it down.
ex.t: Taylor迅速的行动帮助队友冷静下来。

ex.s: George: Nora: Pitt: Use your prior knowledge If you come across a topic you are familiar with, you can think about what you already know about it before you listen.
ex.t: 运用你先前的知识 如果你碰到一个你熟悉的话题，在你听之前可以想想你已经知道的关于它的内容。

ex.s: Using prior knowledge will make it easier for you to predict what you will hear.
ex.t: 运用先前的知识将使你更容易预测你将听到的内容。

defs.def: already existing and therefore more important 优先的；占先的；较重要的
before sth 在 … 前面的

ex.s: Prior to SLEAP, tracking the physical characteristics of both plants and animals required a lot of labor that slowed the scientific process.
ex.t: 在SLEAP出现之前，追踪动植物物理特征需要大量人工，拖慢了科研进程。

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在晚上睡前听放松的音乐。____37____虽然这种观点的有效性仍在评估中，但压力的降低甚至可能与血压有关。同样，根据研究人员的研究，每天只需听30分钟轻音乐，就可能通过减轻压力和焦虑，有助于维持健康的血糖水平。

ex.s: Prior to that, the only great historical works I had been exposed to were Homer’s epic poems.
ex.t: 在那之前，我接触过的仅有的一些伟大历史著作是荷马的史诗。

ex.s: Prior to coming to China, my only experience with Chinese cooking was in America, with Chinese food that had been changed to suit American tastes.
ex.t: 来中国之前，我对中国烹饪的唯一体验是在美国，吃的都是已经改得适合美国口味的中国菜。

ex.s: Prior to modern food processing and storage techniques and the use of greenhouses, most food was essentially seasonal in nature.
ex.t: 在现代食品加工、储存技术和温室使用之前，大多数食物本质上是季节性的。

defs.def: a person who is in charge of a group of monks or nuns living in a priory （小隐修院）上司
(in an abbey) a person next in rank below an abbot or abbess （隐修院）会长，副院长
